text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
My toes feel weird every time I take a 
step...! Did I slack off on trimming my 
nails?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, is this what they call letting your 
guard down too...?! Ugh~, it's making me 
so restless, ss-u~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because her nail care didn't go 
well, Bamboo Memory spent the whole day 
feeling uncomfortable.
